terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Rules for using dobreprinty.pl, placing and fulfilling orders, and the liability of the parties.

items: DobrePrinty – the dobreprinty.pl service operated by {{owner}}, {{address}} (personal data controller), as unregistered business activity within the meaning of Art. 5 of the Act of 6 March 2018 – Entrepreneurs' Law. DobrePrinty is not a registered VAT payer (section 7).
Customer – a natural person, legal person or organisational unit placing an order.
Consumer – a Customer who is a natural person concluding a contract not directly related to their business or professional activity.
Partner print shop – an independent entity that carries out the physical printing after DobrePrinty hands over the job.

blocks.text: DobrePrinty acts as an intermediary between the Customer and partner print shops. We receive the order, check the file technically, select a print shop from our network of verified partners and hand the job over to production. The Customer enters into a service contract with DobrePrinty; all complaints are handled by us, not by the print shop.
Before being admitted to the network, every partner print shop goes through:

items: a print quality audit (test prints in 12 formats)
an on-time delivery check (a test series of 30 orders)
a GDPR and data security audit
quarterly re-audits to keep partner status

blocks.text: You place an order in the product configurator by choosing the quantity and format. The price shown is the final amount payable (DobrePrinty does not add VAT – section 7); it does not include delivery costs, which are selected at the summary step.

sections.heading: 5. Print files and responsibility for content

blocks.text: DobrePrinty does not create graphic designs. Our service covers only the technical preparation (adjustment) for printing of the file supplied by the Customer. We therefore expect files prepared in line with the specification.

items: The Customer supplies the print files and bears sole responsibility for their content and correctness – including spelling, data, prices, layout, resolution, bleed and safe margins, and colour space (CMYK).
File verification on DobrePrinty's side is purely technical (e.g. format, resolution, bleed). We do not check or correct the substantive content, spelling or accuracy of data.

We print according to the file approved by the Customer. Approval of the design or preview by the Customer constitutes acceptance of its content – DobrePrinty is not liable for defects resulting from errors in the materials supplied by the Customer.
If a file does not meet the technical requirements, we may put the order on hold until a correct file is supplied; this extends the lead time.

blocks.text: When ordering, the Customer may add paid additional services. Choosing them is voluntary – declining them means sections 5 and 9 apply.

items: Proof print – a physical test print for approving colours and content before the full run is produced. We guarantee faithful colour reproduction only on the basis of an ordered proof; without it the CMYK tolerance applies (section 9) and complaints concerning colour alone are excluded.

Technical preparation / correction of the print file – paid adjustment of the Customer's file to print requirements (bleed, format, resolution, colour conversion). The service does not include graphic design, editing or proofreading of content.
BLIK, payment card, Przelewy24, Apple Pay, Google Pay
A non-VAT invoice (payment confirmation) generated automatically by the Stripe payment platform and sent to the Customer's e-mail address once the payment is recorded

blocks.text: DobrePrinty operates as unregistered business activity and is not a registered VAT payer. We do not issue VAT invoices. The only document confirming a purchase is the non-VAT invoice issued via the Stripe platform (the payment operator), which contains the seller's and Customer's details, the order description and the amount paid. Prices on the site do not include VAT – there is no tax to deduct. The invoice is sent to the e-mail address given in the order; if you need it resent, write to {{email}}.

The production time shown for a product is indicative and counted from the moment the payment is recorded and the print file is approved; it does not include delivery time. Shipping is by courier or to a parcel locker (DPD, InPost, DHL). The waybill is issued in the name of DobrePrinty, not the partner print shop.

DobrePrinty is not liable for delays and events on the carrier's side (courier, parcel locker) or for circumstances beyond DobrePrinty's control, including force majeure (e.g. breakdowns, random events, actions of public authorities). In such cases the lead time is extended accordingly.
The following differences fall within printing industry standards and do not constitute a defect:

items: colour differences between the on-screen preview (RGB) and the print (CMYK), and between successive runs and production batches;
cutting and positioning tolerance of up to ±2 mm;
slight differences in paper shade, weight and texture resulting from stock availability at the partner print shop;
for bulk runs – overs or unders of up to 5% of the ordered quantity (printing industry standard); we bill the quantity actually delivered.

blocks.text: Faithful colour reproduction is guaranteed only by an ordered proof print (section 6). Without a proof the CMYK tolerance applies and complaints concerning colour alone are excluded. We recommend supplying files in CMYK with a colour profile; colours outside the CMYK gamut may be reproduced with a deviation.

Complaints are accepted within 14 days of receiving the order at {{email}}. We handle them within 7 business days. A complaint must be supported by documentation of the defect (e.g. photos) and – where possible – by making the affected run available.

The primary remedy for an accepted complaint is a reprint (replacement) of the defective part. A refund is granted only when a reprint is impossible or ineffective. A complaint covers only the copies that are actually defective, not the whole run – reprints or refunds are settled proportionally. If the fault lies with the partner print shop, we cover the cost; that is our arrangement with the partner.

Transport damage: the Customer inspects the parcel on receipt. A transport complaint must be supported by documentation of the damage (photos of the packaging and contents) and, for visible damage, a damage report drawn up with the courier.
The following are not subject to complaint: differences within printing tolerances (section 9) and defects resulting from errors in files or materials supplied by the Customer (section 5).

Refunds: if a complaint ends in a refund of the price (in full or proportionally), we refund it via the Stripe platform to the payment method used for the order, within 14 days of accepting the complaint. The refund is confirmed by a document generated by Stripe. Because DobrePrinty operates as unregistered business activity and does not issue VAT invoices (section 7), we do not issue corrective invoices either.

For Customers who are not consumers (businesses), DobrePrinty's liability under statutory warranty is excluded (Art. 558 § 1 of the Civil Code). The above exclusions and limitations do not affect consumer rights arising from mandatory provisions of law.

To the extent permitted by law, DobrePrinty's liability towards Customers who are not consumers is limited to the value of the order (the amount actually paid for the order in question) and does not cover lost profits or indirect losses (e.g. downtime, loss of contracts, third-party claims). The limitation does not apply to damage caused intentionally.
The provisions of this section do not limit DobrePrinty's liability towards consumers to the extent arising from mandatory provisions of law.

Prints are personalised products made to individual order, so under Art. 38 of the Consumer Rights Act they are not subject to the standard 14-day right of withdrawal. An order can be cancelled free of charge until the print data is uploaded; funds paid are refunded via the Stripe platform to the original payment method.

Matters not covered here are governed by Polish law. Disputes with Customers who are not consumers are settled by the court competent for DobrePrinty's registered office; for consumers, jurisdiction is determined in accordance with the applicable provisions. DobrePrinty may amend these terms for important reasons; orders placed before an amendment are governed by the terms in force on the day the order was placed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We explain what personal data we collect, why we need it and what rights you have.

blocks.text: The controller of your personal data is {{name}}, operator of the dobreprinty.pl service. Contact: {{email}}.
We process the data you provide when registering an account, placing an order and using our services:

items: first name, surname, e-mail, phone number, delivery address and invoice details
print data (graphic files), solely for the purpose of fulfilling the order
technical data: IP address, session identifier, browser data
order fulfilment and after-sales service
payment settlement and tax obligations
complaint handling and customer contact
analytics and improving the service (anonymised data)

sections.heading: 4. Sharing data with partner print shops

blocks.text: DobrePrinty acts as an intermediary. Your print files and delivery address are passed on to the selected partner print shop only to the extent necessary to fulfil the order. All our print shops have signed a GDPR-compliant data processing agreement and are audited once a quarter.

items: access to your data, its rectification and erasure
restriction of processing and objection
data portability
lodging a complaint with the President of the Polish Data Protection Office (UODO)

blocks.text: We use essential cookies (login, cart) and statistical cookies (Plausible, with no personal identifiers). We do not use marketing cookies without your consent.
For privacy matters, write to privacy@dobreprinty.pl. We reply within 72 hours.
